cells.note: The Bea page describes an AI coach that joins meetings with permission, sends reflections and chats on request.
The Bea page says users can prepare for a hard decision or conversation with Bea; it does not describe a brief before human coach sessions.
The how it works page describes identity-based pairing, so employees can be paired with a coach of the same race, gender identity or sexual orientation.
The how it works page refers to employees booking a session; it does not describe calendar or video links.
